text: [confident, a little wry] You've typed that same answer a hundred times today.
[warm] Now you only have to write it once.
[clear] Save a reply, give it a short name, and it's ready the moment a customer asks.
[bright, lifted] Type the name, and the whole answer is in the box, ready to send.
[warm, settling] Saved replies are in your support inbox. More time for the hard questions.
